questions.question: Which activity uses the most water in South Africa, and how do farmers use water?
questions.expected_answer: Farming uses the most water in South Africa, more than half of all the water people use. Farmers irrigate crops with water from rivers, dams and boreholes, give water to their animals to drink, and use water to clean dairies and wash fruit and vegetables.

questions.question: How is water used in factories, mines and power stations?
questions.expected_answer: Factories use water to make products, clean machines and cool hot machines. Mines use water to wash ore, cool deep tunnels and keep down dust. Coal power stations boil water into steam to turn turbines and make electricity, and hydroelectric power stations use rushing water from dams to turn turbines.

questions.question: What is recreation? Give three ways people use water for recreation.
questions.expected_answer: Recreation means activities people do for fun, sport and relaxation. People use water for swimming, fishing, sailing, canoeing, rowing, water-skiing and surfing.
